name: recoil_app_destructor
description: RecoilApp::Destructor cleans the embedded FMV states, restores embedded state vtables to RecoilStateBase, and chains to the MFC/OLE base destructor.
known_limits: VC5SP3 11.00.7022 /O2 /Ob1 /MD /GX /Zp4 COFF byte compare now passes with zero unmasked mismatches under recoil_app_register_at_exit after modeling the root destructor as the implicit VC5 destructor over embedded state members and the MFC/OLE base; Binary Ninja body is 168 bytes and the VC object body is 176 bytes with 8 trailing VC NOP bytes trimmed.
The native smoke placement-constructs a RecoilApp, seeds the embedded attract/intro/mission FMV script paths, calls the typed destructor once, and verifies the FMV paths are cleared.
